//ADC_SLEW: config_adcshift (ADC x=30.24) + max-slew/max-cap repair margins. Run in parallel with ppa3_adcshift so the two fixes can be attributed separately.

Why: antfix2/4/5 ss corner had 42 max-slew + 1 max-cap. 21 are sram22 input pins (din/addr/we/clk, lib max_transition 0.351 ns); the rest is one net _1375_/Y (fanout 10, each sink got an antenna diode).
RepairDesignPostGRT runs BEFORE HeuristicDiodeInsertion, so diode load and post-route RC growth were not covered by the 10%/20% default margins -> margins raised to 50%.
The sram22 clk pin is a clock net (not touched by repair_design) -> CTS_MAX_SLEW 0.2 ns for clock-tree characterization.
//ANTENNA_FIX: PPA3 antenna closure, variant 2: raising GRT_ANTENNA_ITERS 3->10 did not help (run ppa3_antenna_fix: the same 2 nets stayed violated
while ~35 diodes were inserted per iteration, and the post-detail-route check ended with 6 nets). Break the long/high-fanout nets instead:
post-GRT design repair with a 300 um max wire length (buffers split the net -> smaller metal area per gate) + heuristic diode insertion.
Run with tools/wsl/122_run_ppa3_variant.sh antfix2. Not the signed-off config.
Variant 3 = variant 2 + MAGIC_CAPTURE_ERRORS=false: Magic prints 'Error while reading cell ... Unknown layer/datatype in boundary' for
label/marker datatypes (64:44, 33:43, 92:44) inside the third-party sram22 GDS; OpenLane treats any such line as fatal (it killed the baseline at WriteLEF too).
Drawing layers are known to Magic, so only marker shapes are skipped; KLayout DRC reads the same GDS as a cross-check.
//COMPLETE_FLOW: antfix3 + signoff checkers non-fatal (ERROR_ON_MAGIC_DRC/KLAYOUT_DRC/LVS/XOR/ILLEGAL_OVERLAPS = false) so the flow runs to the end
and records the true violation counts in final/metrics.json instead of stopping at the first checker. The counts are NOT waived: they stay in the metrics and in the dashboard.
Use: bash 123_resume_ppa3.sh antfix4 <first step id> <source run> <source step dir>. Not the signed-off config.
//ADC_SHIFT: config_antfix4 + ADC u_adc moved from x=40 to x=30.24 (= core left edge 20.24 + default macro halo 10).
Why: at x=40 the halo-cut rows left a 9.7 um row segment (x 20.24-29.90, 116 rows) narrower than the 25.76 um tap pitch, so it got no tap cell.
That produced 57 floating n-well islands (LVS: +57 decap_12, +57 decap_3, +2 fill_1, +59 nets) and 1,853 top-level Magic DRC errors (LU.3 908, LU.2 888, nwell.4 57).
See PPA3_SIGNOFF_ROOT_CAUSE.md. Everything else is identical to config_antfix4.json. Full run from scratch: bash 121_launch_ppa3_detached.sh 126_run_ppa3_full.sh adcshift
//SINGLE_SUPPLY_ADCSHIFT: adcslew (ADC at x=30.24, slew settings) + single-supply RTL + custom PDN (config_pdn_a). Goal: close the last 7 LVS errors (ADC power nets).
Single-supply assumption: ADC vccd/vssd/vdda/vssa are all tied to the standard-cell grid (VPWR/VGND); ignores the real 1.8 V / 3.3 V split. Not the signed-off config.
